segments.en: These are not just physical challenges; the mental challenges are even greater.
Reaching Mars takes about eight months of travel, and during that time one must stay away from family, Earth, and everyday life.
Even after arriving there, communication with Earth is not instant.
Messages are delayed by several minutes.
A red desert all around, a silent atmosphere.
With only a limited number of people, all of this puts the mind to a severe test.
If an emergency arises, help from Earth will not arrive immediately.
The team there must make decisions using only their knowledge, training, and mutual trust.
That is why strong mental resilience, discipline, and team spirit are extremely important.
this is humanity's next goal. First the Moon, then Mars is our destination. One day, if humans settle there successfully,
it will not be just a victory in space, but a new chapter in human history.
The day when humans truly become a multi-planet species will surely come.
